faqs.question: What is a safety funnel?
faqs.answer: It's a filling accessory that screws onto or plugs into a container, built with a flame trap, overfill protection, and a closure head to reduce vapor emission during filling of flammable liquids.

faqs.question: What is overfill protection?
faqs.answer: A built-in mechanism that stops filling before the container's capacity is exceeded, standard on every screw-on funnel.

faqs.question: How does grounding work on this funnel?
faqs.answer: Conductive containers ground through direct contact with the funnel; non-conductive containers, most plastics, use a dedicated grounding connection instead.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right funnel for my container?
faqs.answer: Match your container's opening: a standard DIN thread (50, 51, 61, or 71), a 2" thread, or a buttress thread uses a screw-on funnel, while a Rötzmeier safety can, canister, or barrel uses the matching plug-in funnel.

faqs.question: How do I find the plug-in funnel for my Rötzmeier can, canister, or barrel?
faqs.answer: Use TR1 for safety cans, TR2 or TR2V for safety canisters, and TR3 for safety barrels.

faqs.question: Can the flame trap be cleaned or replaced?
faqs.answer: Yes. It unscrews and removes for cleaning or exchange, rather than requiring the whole funnel to be replaced.

faqs.question: Do the plug-in funnels have overfill protection?
faqs.answer: Overfill protection is explicitly stated only for the TR2V variant; confirm feature details with Inkarp for TR1, TR2, and TR3.

faqs.question: What is the closure head for?
faqs.answer: It reduces the vapor that escapes into the surrounding air while the container is being filled.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the standard and flat ("-180") funnel versions?
faqs.answer: The flat version has a lower profile, useful where clearance above the container is limited; both carry the same core safety features.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Safety Funnels in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on the funnel type and thread size or container match you need. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your requirements are confirmed.

faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for Rötzmeier Safety Funnels in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

longForm.heroLead: Filling a flammable liquid container has two quiet risks: pouring past the top, and static building up until it discharges. This funnel is built against both. Overfill protection stops filling before the container overflows. Grounding handles the static risk directly, through contact for conductive containers, or through a dedicated grounding connection for containers that aren't. A flame trap sits underneath it all, and it unscrews for cleaning or replacement rather than being a fixed, disposable part. A closure head reduces the vapor that escapes while you're filling. Two families cover two different needs: screw-on funnels sized to standard DIN thread openings, or plug-in funnels matched exactly to the Safety Can, Safety Canister, or Safety Barrel you're already using.

body.title: Filling has its own risks, separate from storage.
body.text: Overfilling and static discharge both happen during the filling moment itself, which is exactly what this funnel is built to address.

body.title: Overfill protection stops the problem before it starts.
body.text: Rather than reacting to an overflow, the funnel is built to prevent it during filling.

body.title: Grounding depends on what you're filling into.
body.text: Conductive containers ground through direct contact; non-conductive ones use a dedicated grounding connection instead.

body.title: The flame trap is serviceable, not disposable.
body.text: It unscrews and removes for cleaning or exchange, consistent with the removable-flame-trap approach across Rötzmeier's whole range.

body.title: Two funnel families solve two different problems.
body.text: Screw-on funnels fit standard DIN thread openings across a range of sizes; plug-in funnels are matched specifically to safety cans, canisters, and barrels.

body.title: If you already use a Rötzmeier can, canister, or barrel, there's a named funnel for it.
body.text: TR1, TR2, TR2V, and TR3 map directly to those three product lines.

body.title: Not every funnel carries every feature.
body.text: Screw-on funnels are consistently fully featured; the plug-in funnels are simpler, with overfill protection specifically called out only on the TR2V variant.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the Safety Funnels include overfill protection, static grounding, six DIN thread sizes, and four matched plug-in variants.
Two things go wrong most often while filling a flammable liquid container: it overflows, or static builds up until it discharges. This funnel addresses both directly, not as an afterthought.

Overfill protection is built into every screw-on funnel, stopping the fill before the container's capacity is exceeded. Grounding handles the static risk according to what you're filling into: a conductive container grounds simply through direct contact with the funnel, while a non-conductive one, most plastics, uses a dedicated grounding connection instead, since contact alone won't dissipate the charge.
Tell our team what container material you're filling into, and Inkarp will confirm the correct grounding setup.
